## Summary

The cache preserves the latest saved value.

## Findings

- F1: P0 security Escape the shell argument.
- F2: P1 correctness The counter wraps on overflow. Occurs when: retries exceed the limit.
- F3: P1 security Accept only HTTPS endpoints. Occurs when: a proxy header is present.
- F4: P2 correctness Preserve the original timestamp.
- F5: P2 design Merge the duplicate helpers.
- F6: P2 test Assert the status code.
- F7: P3 design Use a constant for the delimiter.
- F8: P3 docs Describe the exit status.

## Verification

- Read the cache implementation and its unit tests.
